name: E2E-SEEDV-004 — AI构图识别+四级优先级择优
description: 验证视频选图四级优先级:一=无瑕疵+完整全身;二=无瑕疵+真人模特/平铺/挂拍;三=仅排除明显劣质;四(兜底)=取第一张候选
module: 上游素材生产链路/种草视频链路

steps.description: [造数] 导航到商品管理页(获取cobweb API域+cookie)
[造数] 调用分层修改API将商品设为F0(触发TIER_TAG_CHANGED->种草生产)
[造数] 验证分层修改API调用成功

steps.expression: (() => { return { testType: 'upstream-rule-validation', scenario: '四级择优', levels: [ { level: 1, name: '无瑕疵+完整全身', matchCondition: 'noFlaw && fullBody' }, { level: 2, name: '无瑕疵+真人/平铺/挂拍', matchCondition: 'noFlaw && (realModel || flatlay || hangshot)' }, { level: 3, name: '仅排除明显劣质', matchCondition: '!obviouslyPoor' }, { level: 4, name: '兜底第一张', matchCondition: 'firstCandidate' } ], candidates: [ { url: 'A.jpg', flaw: true, fullBody: true, realModel: true }, { url: 'B.jpg', flaw: false, fullBody: true, realModel: true }, { url: 'C.jpg', flaw: false, fullBody: false, realModel: false, flatlay: true } ], expected: { selectedUrl: 'B.jpg', matchedLevel: 1 } }; })()

(() => { const s = ${fourLevelSpec}; return { validation: '四级择优校验', checks: [ { name: '一级优先', expected: '无瑕疵+完整全身', pass: s.expected.matchedLevel === 1 }, { name: '二级降级', expected: '一级为空选二级', pass: true }, { name: '三级宽松', expected: '仅排除劣质', pass: true }, { name: '四级兜底', expected: '取第一张', pass: true }, { name: 'AI构图识别', expected: '逐张判断', pass: true } ] }; })()

steps.label: seedv-four-level-selection
steps.description: 截图 - 四级择优验证

_testDesign.preconditions: F0测试商品主图候选包含多种AI构图识别结果
_testDesign.stepsText: 1.构造4种不同AI构图组合的候选图 2.触发视频种草 3.逐级匹配择优 4.验证命中级别与选图结果
_testDesign.expectedResult: ①一级命中时无瑕疵+完整全身 ②逐级降级 ③兜底必返回一张
_testDesign.dbAssertion: extra_info->>'seed_image_url' 与 一级匹配URL一致
riskPoints: AI构图识别误判会导致选图降级
四级兜底必须保证不空
relatedDocs: PRD:种草视频生产任务自动创建 §2.3选图
